description: Change patient sex from male to female
presentation: A 71-year-old woman who is a former smoker with type 2 diabetes and chronic eosinophilia underwent a noncontrast CT chest for lung cancer screening. The CT revealed new tree-in-bud micronodularity in the right lower lobe, along with bronchial wall thickening and mucus plugging, not present on imaging from 5 years prior. She remembers a self-limited cough several weeks ago, has no current respiratory symptoms, and has no other systemic complaints or history of reflux. Is additional follow-up needed?
